title: Fleet playbook claim ledger
description: Every substantive claim in the playbook must have a ledger entry proving it is cited to a source commit. An entry with an empty or placeholder sha is invalid.

node_id.description: GitHub node_id of the source repo — the identity the manifest and diff are joined on. OPTIONAL for backward compatibility with ledgers written before this field existed; when present it is what validate-citations.sh matches on, which is what makes a citation survive a rename and refuse a reused name.

repo.description: owner/name of the source repo AS OF curated_at — human-readable, and MUTABLE: a rename changes it and a reused name can point somewhere else entirely. Kept for readability; node_id is the key.

path.description: file path within the repo the claim was read from

sha.description: the commit the claim was read at — no placeholders

curated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp this claim was last verified

claim.description: optional human-readable summary of what the entry backs
